limitations: Tiny authored one-line defects; not naturally occurring production incidents or broad debugging difficulty.
One model family, no human participants, no statistical/general speedup claim; repeated conditions on one case are not independent new cases.
Concurrent agents and installation/browser/model rehearsal background tasks may affect wall-clock comparisons.
Fixed protected tests validate targeted behavior only; no participant ran the full upstream test suite.
Absolute workspace paths replaced by <workspace> in published copy; hashes refer to original retained local bytes.
